# Tests the per-PR gate (.github/workflows/ci.yml) is allowed to run. FROZEN.
#
# These stay on the macOS / Windows jobs because the claim each pins is about
# that platform's toolchain (Metal, MSVC); most also run on the weekly Linux
# lane. This list does not grow. New tests run on the weekly unfiltered lane
# (.github/workflows/sanitizers.yml) the moment they are declared in
# tests/tests.cmake; they do not get a `ctest -R` step in ci.yml.
# tools/check_ci_test_gate.py fails Static checks (a required check) when
# ci.yml's -R patterns resolve to a name that is not here. Removing a test
# from ci.yml: run
#     python tools/check_ci_test_gate.py --update
# and commit the shorter list; --update only ever removes names. Adding one is
# a hand edit to this file — the diff is the review signal the freeze exists
# to produce, and it needs a maintainer's reason in the PR body.
#
# One name per line, sorted.

cross_needle_meter_test
digital_voice_waveform_process_test
dstar_model_test
mac_nr_filter_test
